_note: DRAFTED. The thinnest batch so far, and correctly: several of these types have almost no protective devices and little to record. Not padded.
subject: PLUMBING FIXTURES
_sparse_note: A fixture has no protective device and no start-up readings in the usual sense. What it has is a temperature that can scald and a trap that can siphon. Three and three, and padding it would invent checks nobody performs.

items.label: Anti-scald / thermostatic limit verified at the outlet
Trap seal present and primed; no siphonage on adjacent discharge
Emergency fixture (eyewash / shower) flow and activation proven where fitted
items.convergence_reason: FIRM PRACTICE — fifty years of Isotherm field practice, cited as the anchor because the code set is silent here. Not dressed as a standard. An emergency fixture is a life-safety device that no start-up form in the corpus treats as one.

items.label: Hot water temperature at the outlet (°C)
Static and flowing pressure at the fixture (kPa)
Flow rate at the outlet (L/min)
items.convergence_reason: FIRM PRACTICE — fifty years of Isotherm field practice, cited as the anchor because the code set is silent here. Not dressed as a standard. Recorded so a low-flow complaint later has a starting number.
